body_markdown:
- Lithium Series Brick allows residential photovoltaic installations to expand their storage capacity through stackable 5.12 kWh modules.
- The company will showcase its residential battery range, together with a selection of Deye batteries and hybrid inverters, to installers and industry professionals.


[Editar esta traducción en Español](https://umbrella-e.com/wp-admin/post.php?post=5656&action=edit)


***Madrid, November 24, 2026*** – Turbo Energy (Nasdaq: TURB), a global integrator of solar energy storage solutions and AI-driven intelligent energy management systems, is presenting Lithium Series Brick at GENERA 2026, a low-voltage modular stackable battery designed for residential photovoltaic installations.


Its modular design allows installers to configure storage capacity according to the energy needs of each home and expand it at a later stage if consumption increases. Depending on the configuration, the modules can be connected to one another without external cabling. The battery has an IP65 protection rating.


The new battery expands Turbo Energy’s residential portfolio within its Distribution business line, which is focused on the professional channel.


At IFEMA MADRID, the company will also showcase its Lithium Series Pro batteries and a selection of Deye batteries and hybrid inverters for residential and commercial solar installations.


*Residential energy storage area and Deye solutions at the Turbo Energy stand at GENERA 2026.*


“Every solar installation has different storage requirements. With Lithium Series Brick, we want to offer installers a modular solution that can be adapted to each project and expanded as customer needs evolve. At GENERA, they will be able to see the different configurations first-hand and receive guidance on the storage solutions and inverters that are best suited to their installations,” said Manuel C. D’Aversa, Business Development Manager for Turbo Energy’s Distribution business line.


The company will also present its capabilities in the integration of energy storage and intelligent energy management solutions for industrial projects, combining photovoltaic generation, energy storage systems and proprietary energy management software.


One of its key references is Pamesa Net Zero, a program developed by Umbrella Global Energy in which Turbo Energy supplies the energy storage systems and develops the intelligent energy management software.


In October 2026, Turbo Energy announced that 62.5 MWh of energy storage had entered operation across three industrial sites within the program.


Turbo Energy will be present from **November 24 to 26 at Stand 10D01, Hall 10, IFEMA MADRID** .
